# Nymrel Agent

> Nymrel Agent is an explainable, deterministic multi-model router from Nymrel. The hosted API accepts model metadata only; it does not accept prompts or provider credentials.

## Core operation

POST /v1/route accepts exactly `request` and `models`. It filters models by health, risk class, data boundary, tool use, structured output, context size, modality, cost, and latency. Eligible models are ranked under `balanced`, `quality`, `cost`, or `latency` objectives. An explicit cost or latency ceiling anchors its matching score component, preventing unrelated catalog changes from changing that component; an omitted ceiling uses eligible-set normalization. Without changing the closed v1 response shape, responses disclose normalization modes in `decisionCodes` and numeric bounds in `explanation`, alongside the selection, ranked candidates, rejected candidates, score components, and a request ID.

POST /v2/route is an explicit separate contract. Its request includes `normalization` with `basis: request_budget` and positive cost and latency anchors. It filters eligibility, computes a sorted Pareto frontier with quality/reliability/health higher-is-better and cost/latency lower-is-better, then selects only from that frontier using deterministic weighted scores. An incumbent can break an exact frontier score tie only; it has no score bonus. v2 responses include `normalization` and `paretoFrontierModelIds`.

## Important boundaries

- Hosted routing is stateless application logic and does not execute model calls.
- Model metrics and capabilities are supplied by the caller; Nymrel Agent does not certify them.
- The local harness executes read-only requests only.
- Provider credentials remain on the customer's machine for local execution.
- Write-capable tools, hosted credential custody, billing, and autonomous side effects are outside v0.2.

## Service

Nymrel offers on-request implementation work for model catalogs, evaluation, routing policy, local adapters, and operational receipts. Scope and pricing are provided after a project brief.
